newsitem.title: UK: Ahern made MD of Disney international TV.
newsitem.headline: Ahern made MD of Disney international TV.

text.p: Joseph Ahern has been appointed Managing Director, Broadcasting, at Walt Disney Television International, the company said on Thursday.
Ahern, who takes up his new position in March, replaces David Simon, who has resigned from the company to take up a new job with another employer.

Ahern will oversee the management and broadcasting interests of Walt Disney Television International. These include Disney channels in Britain, Taiwan and Australia plus stakes in Britain's GMTV and Super RTL of Germany. Additional Disney channels will be launched shortly in the Middle East and France.
Ahern has been general manager of WLS-TV, an ABC-owned station in Chicago, for the past 12 years.
